content: dinit shutdown on Alpine: busybox poweroff sends SIGUSR2 (dinit ignores it — handles SIGINT=reboot/SIGTERM=halt/SIGQUIT=now only) → silent no-op, exit 0; dinitctl shutdown sends HALT (QEMU stays up); correct POWEROFF = dinit-poweroff (dinit-shutdown package); the dinit daemon itself execs /usr/sbin/dinit-shutdown --system -p/-r/-h to FINALIZE any shutdown — package is mandatory. FeralOS installer ships it + wires /usr/bin/{poweroff,halt,shutdown} symlinks and {reboot,soft-reboot} wrappers (name-based detection needs the dinit- prefix)

2026-09-25 session: harness run phases ([harness] phase N/9 -> stdout + runs/<ts>/harness.log); init-aware target poweroff (enableDinit -> /usr/sbin/dinit-poweroff, else poweroff; 5m fail-not-hang; no force quit; verify check dinit_shutdown_commands); installer corePkgs += dinit-shutdown + user-facing shutdown commands; verified dinit 48/48 (2m41s), OpenRC 39/39 (2m32s), live debug_run reboot/poweroff test; milestone log moved AGENTS.md -> CHANGELOG.md (## Milestone Log). Next: real hardware test, btrfsStandardUnencrypted

Harness dinit verify checks were unfalsifiable: '&& echo ok || echo fail' always exits 0 and Verify marks PASS on exit code 0 → false green (8 of 9 dinit_* checks). Fixed: all dinit checks exit non-zero via '|| { echo <fail>; exit 1; }'; dinit_pid1 reads /proc/1/comm (busybox ps has no -p); dinitctl_status uses 'dinitctl list' (bare 'dinitctl status' needs <service-name>); dinit_feralos_repo greps /etc/apk/repositories.d/feralos.list (keyring install path). Verified btrfs_standard_dinit 48/48 (run 2026-09-24T23-42-02Z).

Made harness dinit verify checks falsifiable (exit-code based, no bare || echo fallback); fixed 3 broken commands (busybox ps -p, bare dinitctl status, repo path repositories.d). 48/48 dinit run green with truthful details. Next: upstream dinitctl --offline issue; sd-tools PR.
